fields.name: 🚜 Mining Fleet Real-Time Health & Operating States

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS machine_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.machine_model') AS model, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.operating_state') AS state, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.vibration_rms') AS rms_g, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.crest_factor') AS crest_factor, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.kurtosis') AS kurtosis, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.battery_millivolts') AS battery_mv, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.ingest_mode') AS mode FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MachineVibrationSample' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30

fields.name: 💥 Heavy Equipment Abuse & Severe Shock Incidents

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS machine_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.incident_id') AS incident_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.peak_g') AS peak_g, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.abuse_severity') AS severity, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.incident_type') AS incident_type, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.recommendation') AS recommendation FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'EquipmentAbuseIncident' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

view.title: Structural Shock & Excessive G-Force Log (CEL Triggered)

fields.name: 🛠️ AI Predictive Maintenance Work Orders & RUL Matrix

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS machine_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.component') AS component, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.diagnosed_failure_mode') AS failure_mode, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.defect_severity') AS severity, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.estimated_remaining_useful_life_hours') AS INTEGER) AS rul_hours, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.confidence_score') AS confidence, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.work_order_priority') AS priority, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.recommended_action') AS action FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'PredictiveMaintenanceDiagnosis' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

view.title: Cognitive SLM Bearing Defect Diagnoses & Actionable Work Orders
